facts.fact: Manzini Municipal Council says rates were billed in April 2020 and that some property owners had not paid since, which it tracks by account and plot number; in December 2020 it added the Eswatini Mobile e-Mali wallet to MTN Mobile Money, EFT, debit order, card and cash at the Rates Hall.
Only the Municipal Council of Manzini is described; no count of other Eswatini local governments is given.
In December 2020 Manzini activated e-Mali as a new rates payment channel, with an airtime promotion for payments of E500 or more through 31 December 2020.
